content: शोभा [शुभ्-अ] .²1 Light, lustre, brilliance, radiance. .²2 .³({%a%}) Splendour, beauty, elegance, grace, loveliness; वपुरभिनवमस्याः पुष्यति स्वां न शोभाम् <ls>Ś. 1. 19</ls>; <ls>Me. 54</ls>, <ls n="Me.">61</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .³({%b%}) Natural beauty, grandeur (as of a mountain); अद्रिशोभा <ls>R. 2. 27</ls>. .²3 An ornament, graceful expression; शोभैव मन्दरक्षुब्धक्षुभिताम्भोधिवर्णना <ls>Śi. 2. 107</ls>. .²4 Turmeric. .²5 A kind of pigment (= गोरोचना <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²6 Distinguished merit. .²7 Colour, hue. .²8 Wish, desire.
